The addition of `0.5f` to the integer pixel indices (`ix`, `iy`) corresponds to the `0.5` offset mentioned in the claim. This offset is standard practice in ray tracing to ensure the ray passes through the center of the pixel rather than the corner, which avoids edge artifacts. Therefore, the evidence supports the claim that the 0.5 offset ensures rays hit the center of the pixel.
